title: Comparing Numbers Worksheets: 3-Digit Numbers
intro: Teach three-digit comparison from the greatest place value.
html:
Teaching notes for parents and teachers

How to teach it

Compare hundreds first, then tens and ones only when needed. Use a place-value chart to explain the first difference.

Example to work through together

Use the model below as you explain the example. Have your student point to the quantities as you discuss them.

Compare the same places
NumberHundredsTensOnes
482482
428428

Ask your student

Do we need to compare the ones if the hundreds are different?

If your student needs help

If the student starts with the last digit, rebuild both numbers with hundreds, tens, and ones.
